attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across the Antrieb-managed cluster: node1 is the writable primary, node2 and node3 are read-only standbys built via pg_basebackup -R with a dedicated `replicator` role. Verified inserts on node1 replicate to both standbys and that standbys reject writes. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), proving changed boot identity on each and full replication/data recovery afterward.
